category_lock.scope: this normalized affine two-parameter family only

theorem_lock.full_fixed_algebra: B_n=A[z_0,...,z_(n-1)]/(g_0,...,g_(n-1)) is free of rank d^n with standard monomial basis 0<=e_i<d
theorem_lock.generic_actual_block: the actual exact-period-n clopen idempotent block E_n of B_n tensor_A K is one field of degree nu
theorem_lock.relative_normalization: S, the integral closure of A in E_n, is finite locally free of rank nu and Spec(S) is geometrically integral over Q
theorem_lock.scalar_point_fiber: S/aS is exactly D_n=Q[c,z]/(Phi_(d,n)(z,c)), hence the Gao-Ou affine Y_1(n), with reducedness and no hidden nilpotents
theorem_lock.cycle_quotient: S_0=S^(C_n) is finite locally free of rank r and S_0/aS_0 is D_n^(C_n), the affine X_0(n)
theorem_lock.geometric_cycle_monodromy: on a common dense finite-etale open, the geometric monodromy on the r cycles is S_r
theorem_lock.subordinate_marked_point_corollary: on the common dense finite-etale open, marked-point monodromy is C_n wr S_r by scalar restriction lower bound and the global time-shift centralizer upper bound; this is not advertised as a separate novelty claim

observables.trace_guard: rho is pointwise matrix trace of DH^n, not Tr_(F/K), and not det(DH^n)=(-a)^n

theorem_lock.primitive_coordinates: for F=Frac(S_0)=E_n^(C_n), K(tau)=F=K(rho), proved separately until the common S_r stabilizer step
theorem_lock.characteristic_polynomials: for s in {tau,rho}, det(T*id-m_s) is defined on the determinant line wedge_A^r S_0, lies in A[T], and is irreducible of degree r over K
theorem_lock.degree_one_boundary: for (d,n)=(2,2), nu=2, r=1, tau=a-1, z_0*z_1=(a-1)^2+c, rho=4*a^2-6*a+4+4*c; this is not nontrivial monodromy evidence

proof_dependency_lock.P1_monic_grobner: LM(g_i)=z_i^d, pairwise coprime monic leading monomials, coefficient-ring division, rank d^n
proof_dependency_lock.P2_generic_actual_factor: generic etaleness, Galois-stable actual-period idempotent, Mobius rank nu, no embedded all-fiber actual-period subscheme
proof_dependency_lock.P3_henselian_connected_lift: A_(a) and its henselization lift the scalar exact factor uniquely; lower-period closed loci identify the lift with E_n and rule out product idempotents
proof_dependency_lock.P4_finite_flat_normalization: excellence and Nagata finiteness, normal-surface Cohen-Macaulayness, local dimension equality, and miracle flatness
proof_dependency_lock.P5_exact_scalar_fiber: unique height-one prime over (a), ramification index e=1, residue degree nu, div_S(a) a single multiplicity-one prime, R0+S1 reducedness, torsion-rank nilpotent exclusion, and finite birational comparison with normal D_n
proof_dependency_lock.P6_geometric_constants: algebraic constants inject into Frac(D_n), so Q is algebraically closed in E_n and Spec(S) is geometrically integral
proof_dependency_lock.P7_invariants: faithful generic order-n shift, Reynolds direct summand, arbitrary base-change compatibility, and exact affine quotient fiber
proof_dependency_lock.P8_monodromy: Morton 1998 Theorem D/Theorem 10 plus Fakhruddin 2014 Theorem 3.2 give geometric scalar C_n wr S_r; pi_1 of the scalar good line maps into global pi_1; global point action lies in the shift centralizer; cycle quotient is S_r
proof_dependency_lock.P9_tau_nonbase: primitive infinity words have different leading word sums; Morton 1996 Corollary 3 and p.336 are a direct scalar alternate for d=2, while the uniform route includes d>=3
proof_dependency_lock.P10_rho_nonbase: the same branches are evaluated independently using leading inverse word products in pointwise derivative trace; Morton 1996 Corollary 1 and pp.335-336 are a direct scalar alternate for all d,n
proof_dependency_lock.P11_primitivity: for r>1, maximality of S_(r-1) in S_r turns each separate nonbase result into field generation
proof_dependency_lock.P12_top_wedge: basis-free determinant line, nonzero 1 wedge s wedge ... wedge s^(r-1), and nonzero Vandermonde/discriminant
proof_dependency_lock.P13_small_case: direct two-equation derivation of the complete (2,2) formulas and explicit rejection of nontrivial monodromy inference
